en.editorNote: For posts about coming of age, leaving home, or parents learning to let go.
variations: She didn't stop worrying. She just put the incense away and let me go.
Sixteen years of praying, and last night she quietly stopped.

items.sourceNote: 武俠題材「農曆七月人人思歸」之原創發想，非任何劇集台詞。

zh-tw.content: 七月裡江湖的刀收得特別早。不是怕什麼，是這個月人人都想起：家裡還有人在等。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合農曆七月的貼文，或想收心、想家、提早回家吃飯的時候。
variations: 這個月的江湖特別安靜，因為人人都急著回家吃頓飯。
刀收得早，不是怕，是想家。

en.content: In the seventh month, blades go back in their sheaths early. Not from fear — it's the month everyone remembers someone at home is still waiting.
en.editorNote: For posts about the seventh lunar month, or any season that turns people toward home.
variations: The seventh month is the quietest season out on the road — everyone is hurrying home for dinner.
Blades put away early. Not fear. Homesickness.

items.sourceNote: 七夕落雨的民間說法之原創改寫，非任何劇集台詞。

zh-tw.content: 都說今夜這場雨，是天上那位捨不得走才落的。我倒不信——一年只見得上一面，眼淚哪捨得花在見著的那天。這雨啊，是替底下這些話說不出口的人下的。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合七夕當晚下雨時發，也適合心意藏很久還沒開口的人。
variations: 見面那天的眼淚太貴，捨不得掉。
這雨不是天上的人流的，是底下沒開口的人欠的。

en.content: They say tonight's rain is the parting up in the sky. I don't buy it — when you only get one meeting a year, you don't spend your tears on the day you finally meet. This rain falls for the rest of us down here, the ones who still haven't said it out loud.
en.editorNote: Good for a rainy Qixi night, or for anyone who has been holding something back too long.
variations: Tears on the day you finally meet are too expensive to spend.
That rain isn't falling from above. It's owed by the people down here who never spoke up.

items.sourceNote: 古裝劇常見的蒙館開課場景之原創改寫，非任何劇集台詞。

zh-tw.content:
先生問：你們來讀書，是為了什麼？
滿堂搶著答：中舉、做官、光宗耀祖。
最小的那個站起來說：我娘不識字。人家寫什麼，她都得求人念給她聽；念的人說是什麼，她就只能信什麼。我想自己讀。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合開學季、談讀書意義或家庭故事的貼文。
variations: 別人念給你聽的，永遠是別人想讓你聽的那一種。
我讀書不為中舉，是想替我娘自己看一次。

en.content:
The teacher asked why we had come to study. The whole room shouted the same answers: pass the exams, hold office, bring the family honor.
The smallest boy stood up last. "My mother can't read. Whatever anyone writes to her, she has to ask someone to read it aloud — and whatever they say it says, she has to believe. I want to read it myself."
en.editorNote: For back-to-school posts, or anything about why reading and learning actually matter.
variations: Whatever gets read aloud to you is always someone else's version.
I'm not studying to pass exams. I want to read one letter to my mother myself.

items.sourceNote: 朝堂權謀劇常見的「以退為進」橋段之原創改寫，非任何劇集台詞。

zh-tw.content: 我讓的那一步不是輸。位子空出來了，看誰第一個急著坐。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合談職場退讓、談判拉鋸，或追權謀劇時的貼文。
variations: 讓一步不是認輸，是騰出一個測人心的空位。
有人搶著坐的那個位子，多半是我不想坐的。

en.content: Stepping back wasn't losing. It just left the seat empty — now we get to see who rushes to sit in it first.
en.editorNote: For posts about office politics, negotiation standoffs, or binge-watching a court intrigue drama.
variations: Backing off isn't surrender. It's leaving an empty chair to see who lunges.
Whoever grabs the seat fastest just told me everything about him.

items.sourceNote: 宮廷劇朝議場景的原創改寫，非任何劇集台詞。

zh-tw.content: 廷議上我一句話沒說。散朝後急著來問我怎麼想的那幾個，我就都認得了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合談會議裡的沉默、談看人，或職場觀察類貼文。
variations: 沉默最好用的地方，是它會替我把人分好類。
我不表態的那半個時辰，比說十句話都管用。

en.content: I said nothing in council all morning. The ones who cornered me afterward to ask what I thought — those I know by name now.
en.editorNote: For posts about staying quiet in meetings, reading a room, or workplace people-watching.
variations: Silence's best trick is that it sorts people for you.
The half hour I stayed quiet did more work than ten speeches would have.

items.sourceNote: 權謀劇「誰先沉不住氣」對峙橋段的原創改寫，非任何劇集台詞。

zh-tw.content: 他遞了三回台階給我，我一回也沒下。第四回，他自己站上去了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合談忍耐、談判僵持，或吵架時誰先低頭的貼文。
variations: 不肯下的那個台階，最後多半是搭給對方走的。
他一直遞台階，其實是他比我更想把這件事結束。

en.content: He offered me a graceful way out three times. I took none of them. The fourth time, he climbed onto it himself.
en.editorNote: For posts about patience, stalled negotiations, or who blinks first in an argument.
variations: The exit you keep refusing is usually the one built for the other guy.
Handing me an out three times meant he wanted this over more than I did.

items.sourceNote: 宮廷劇罰跪橋段的原創改寫，非任何劇集台詞。

zh-tw.content: 殿上罰跪那兩個時辰，我沒喊過一聲冤。喊了的那個，如今不在殿上了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合談忍耐、被冤枉沒人替你說話，或追宮鬥劇的貼文。
variations: 先喊疼的人，通常不是最疼的那一個。
跪著那兩個時辰，我只做一件事——記住誰在看。

en.content: Two hours kneeling on the hall floor, and I never once cried injustice. The man who did isn't standing in that hall anymore.
en.editorNote: For posts about enduring a bad stretch quietly, being wrongly blamed, or palace-drama nights.
variations: The first one to yell that it hurts is rarely the one hurting most.
For those two hours I did exactly one thing: memorized who was watching.

items.sourceNote: 武俠劇「退役刀客」母題的原創改寫，非任何劇集台詞。

zh-tw.content: 刀柄磨了二十年，虎口那層繭厚得連筷子都握不穩。他們勸我回鄉過幾天安穩日子——安穩我學得會，難的是每回熱湯端上桌，這隻手得先鬆三次才敢伸出去。旁人當我怕燙。其實甲我卸得下來，握了半輩子的那個姿勢，手不肯還我。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合談職業病、離開一個待太久的地方，或身體比腦子更早記住的那些習慣。
variations: 兵器我早交回去了，只有這雙手還天天以為自己在值夜。
繭是身體替你記的日誌，你想忘，它一頁也不肯撕。

en.content: Twenty years on a saber grip left a callus in the web of my hand thick enough that chopsticks slide right out of it. Everyone tells me to go home and live a few quiet years. Quiet I can learn. The hard part is that every time a hot bowl lands on the table, this hand has to unclench three times before it will reach. They think I'm afraid of the heat. The armor I can take off. The grip I held for half a lifetime won't give my hand back.
en.editorNote: For posts about occupational habits, leaving a place you stayed at too long, or the body remembering before the mind does.
variations: I handed the weapon back years ago. My hands still report for the night watch.
A callus is the diary your body keeps for you, and it won't tear out a single page.

items.sourceNote: 市井匠人說理型台詞的原創改寫，醃菜壓石比喻為自創，非任何劇集台詞。

zh-tw.content: 這缸菜醃了三代，訣竅說穿了只有一塊石頭。壓輕了不入味，壓重了爛在缸底，壓多久更是學問——同一塊石頭，三個月是好菜，三年就只剩一個鹹字。你們天天要我再忍一忍，我忍。可你們也得替我記著，哪一天該把石頭挪開。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合談忍耐是有期限的、長期被要求配合，或勸人別把委屈醃太久的貼文。
variations: 壓上去那塊石頭是為了入味，不是為了把人壓成一缸鹹水。
誰放的石頭，誰就得記得什麼時候搬走。

en.content: This crock has been pickling for three generations, and the whole secret is one stone. Too light and the flavor never sinks in; too heavy and everything rots at the bottom; how long you leave it there is the real craft. The same stone gives you good vegetables at three months and nothing but salt at three years. You keep telling me to bear it a little longer. Fine, I'll bear it. Just mark the day the stone comes off.
en.editorNote: For posts about patience having a deadline, being asked to accommodate indefinitely, or telling someone to stop marinating in a bad situation.
variations: The stone is there to season you, not to press you down into brine.
Whoever set the weight owes you the day it gets lifted.

items.sourceNote: 古裝感情戲「過度順從」橋段的原創改寫，非任何劇集台詞。

zh-tw.content: 你答應得太快了。我說什麼你都點頭，連我說錯的那回也點。把一個「不」字收得這麼緊的人，多半沒打算久留。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合談過度討好、感情裡的敷衍，或看穿一個人其實早就想走的貼文。
variations: 肯跟我頂一句的人，才是還打算留下來吃飯的人。
你不是好說話，你是不打算再為這裡花力氣了。

en.content: You agree too fast. Whatever I say, you nod — you nodded the time I was flat-out wrong, too. Someone holding on to the word no that tightly usually isn't planning to stay.
en.editorNote: For posts about people-pleasing, half-hearted agreement in a relationship, or noticing someone has already checked out.
variations: The one willing to push back is the one still planning to stay for dinner.
You're not easygoing. You've just stopped spending energy here.

items.sourceNote: 古裝離別戲「長亭送別」母題的原創改寫，非任何劇集台詞。

zh-tw.content: 送到城外那座亭子就夠了，再遠也只是拖著。別離其實不在你翻身上馬那一下，也不在我鬆開韁繩那一下——是馬蹄聲拐過林子那個彎、忽然聽不見的那半息。前頭幾步我都笑著撐過去了，就那半息，我得扶著亭柱站一會兒，等這口氣自己回來。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合談送別、車站機場目送，或那種「人走遠了才真的痛起來」的貼文。
variations: 最難熬的不是看著你走，是連聲音也走了。
我沒送你到最後，我只是站到聽不見為止。

en.content: The pavilion outside the city wall is far enough; anything past that is just dragging it out. The parting isn't the moment you swing up onto the horse, and it isn't the moment I let go of the reins. It's the half-breath after the hoofbeats round the bend in the trees and go suddenly silent. I smiled my way through everything before that. For that half-breath I have to hold on to the pavilion post and wait for my breathing to come back on its own.
en.editorNote: For goodbye posts, station and airport farewells, or the kind of ache that only lands after the person is out of sight.
variations: The hard part isn't watching you go. It's when the sound goes too.
I didn't walk you all the way out. I just stood there until I couldn't hear you anymore.

items.sourceNote: 2026/8 勞退自提新制報導引發的「替自己留一條退路」討論，轉為古裝家僕私房錢母題的原創寫作，非任何劇集台詞。

zh-tw.content: 我進府第一年就在灶房牆角埋了個瓦罐，往裡頭丟第一枚錢。二十三年，一個月也沒斷過。您別急著皺眉——不是我信不過這個家，是我看過太多人把後半輩子整個押在別人的良心上，賭輸了連討碗飯的地方都沒有。這罐子我大概到死都不會挖出來。可光是知道它埋在那兒，我這腰桿，就比同屋的人直了一寸。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合聊存錢、經濟獨立、勞退自提，或那種「替自己留一條誰也拿不走的後路」的貼文。
variations: 靠山會塌，交情會淡，只有牆角那罐錢，二十三年一聲不吭。
那罐子不必挖出來，光是埋著，就替我壯了二十三年的膽。

en.content: My first year working in this house, I buried a clay jar in the corner of the kitchen and dropped one coin in it. Twenty-three years, never missed a month. Don't frown at me yet — this isn't distrust. I've watched too many people stake the entire back half of their lives on somebody else's conscience, lose, and end up with nowhere to go for a bowl of rice. I'll probably die without ever digging that jar up. But knowing it's down there has kept my back an inch straighter than anyone else's under this roof.
en.editorNote: For posts about saving, financial independence, retirement contributions, or keeping one way out that nobody else can take from you.
variations: Patrons collapse, friendships thin out. That jar in the corner has stayed quiet for twenty-three years.
I never had to dig it up. Knowing it was buried there gave me nerve for twenty-three years.

items.sourceNote: 2026/8 防空演習警報引發的「演習擾民」網路討論，轉為古裝烽火台空演母題的原創寫作，非任何劇集台詞。

zh-tw.content: 城樓上每年都要空舉一次烽火。狼煙一起，滿城雞飛狗跳，罵我們擾民的話我聽了十幾年——說什麼太平年月，拿百姓的膽子尋開心。我照舉。真要命的那一夜不會先派人來知會你一聲，等它來了，你腦子是空的，能救你的只剩手腳早就練熟的那幾步。腦子會嚇傻，手不會。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合聊防災演練、消防演習、SOP 訓練，或提醒「平常多練一次，關鍵時刻少想一秒」的工作貼文。
variations: 平時多演一遍，是為了那一夜你不必用腦子。
被罵擾民我認了，總好過那一夜滿城的人不知道往哪裡跑。

en.content: Every year we light the beacon on the wall for nothing. The smoke goes up, the whole city loses its head, and I've spent a decade hearing people call it a nuisance — peacetime, they say, and you're playing games with people's nerves. I light it anyway. The night that actually matters won't send word ahead. When it comes, your mind will be blank, and the only thing left to save you is the handful of steps your hands already know cold. Your head panics. Your hands don't.
en.editorNote: For posts about fire drills, emergency practice, SOP training, or the idea that one extra rehearsal buys you a second you won't have to spend thinking.
variations: We rehearse now so that on the real night nobody has to think.
Call it a nuisance. Better that than a city with nowhere to run and no idea it's time.

items.sourceNote: 古裝市井商賈題材（秤桿十六星俗諺）的原創改寫，非任何劇集台詞。

zh-tw.content: 這根秤桿上刻了十六顆星。前十三顆記斤兩，後三顆記的是福、祿、壽。師父收我那天說：短人一兩折福，短二兩折祿，短三兩，往後的命自己去算。我當年只當是嚇唬學徒的話。站了三十年櫃檯才看懂——那三顆星刻的位置有講究，正好落在我抬手秤東西、眼睛垂下來就看得見的地方。客人看不看得見，那是另一回事。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合聊職業良心、做生意的底線，或那種「沒人盯著的時候你怎麼做」的職場貼文。
variations: 最後那三顆星，從來不是刻給客人看的。
手一抬起來，良心擺在哪，我自己看得最清楚。

en.content: Sixteen stars are carved into this steelyard. The first thirteen mark the weight. The last three stand for fortune, standing, and long life. The day my master took me on, he said: shortchange a customer once and you spend your fortune; twice, your standing; three times, work out the rest of your life for yourself. I thought it was something you say to scare an apprentice. Thirty years behind this counter and I finally understand where those three stars sit — exactly where my eyes land when I lift the beam to weigh something. Whether the customer can see them is a separate question.
en.editorNote: For posts about professional conscience, the line you won't cross in business, or what a person does when nobody is checking.
variations: Those last three stars were never carved for the customer.
Lift the beam and your conscience is right there in your line of sight.

items.sourceNote: 古裝甜寵「等人歸家」母題的原創寫作，非任何劇集台詞。

zh-tw.content: 後院那道木階，第三級鬆了整整三年，我一直沒喊人來釘。爹娘催過，管事也催過，我都推說忙。其實是你每回進門都要踩它一下，那聲「咿呀」隔著兩道門我都聽得見。聽見了，我才有工夫把湯挪回爐上、把帳本攤開、把嘴角壓平，裝成一副早就坐在這裡對數的樣子。這階你哪天想釘就釘吧——反正我如今也懶得裝了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合寫等人回家、同居日常，或那種「嘴上說沒在等、其實整個人都在聽門口」的甜蜜貼文。
variations: 那級會響的階梯我留了三年，就為了先一步知道你回來了。
我早就坐好了——早到你剛踩上那一階的時候。

en.content: The third step of the back stairs has been loose for three full years and I've never called anyone to fix it. My parents nagged. The steward nagged. I kept saying I was busy. The truth is you step on it every time you come home, and that creak carries through two doors. Hearing it gives me exactly enough time to move the soup back over the fire, open the ledger, flatten my mouth, and look like someone who has been sitting here doing accounts all evening. Nail it down whenever you like. I've stopped bothering to pretend.
en.editorNote: For posts about waiting for someone to get home, live-in couple moments, or acting unbothered while your whole body is listening for the door.
variations: I left that step creaking for three years just so I'd know first.
I was already sitting up straight — since the second you hit that step.

items.sourceNote: 2026 下半年古裝劇的家宅庭園意象與老僕對白風潮，此則改寫為老園丁與少主的問答，台詞為原創撰寫，非劇中原句

zh-tw.content:
「這棵樹移過來三年了，怎麼還是不開花？」
「移得太好了——土是從老宅整車拉來的，水照舊時的時辰澆，連朝向都替它擺得一模一樣。」
「那不是很妥當嗎？」
「妥當得它到今天都還以為自己沒離開過——樹要開花，得先知道自己已經站在這裡了。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合寫換工作、搬到新城市、離開一段舊關係後遲遲安不下心的貼文；配庭院老樹或移栽的照片很有味道。
variations: 東西全搬過來了，人還留在原地，難怪長不出新的。
先承認自己已經到了，花才肯開。

en.content:
"That tree's been here three years. Why won't it flower?"
"Because the move went too well — we hauled the soil over by the cartload from the old house, watered it at the same hour as always, even set it facing the exact same way."
"Isn't that doing it properly?"
"So properly that it still thinks it never left. A tree won't bloom until it knows where it's standing now."
en.editorNote: For posts about a new job, a new city, or being somewhere new while your head is still back home; pairs with garden and old-tree photos.
variations: You moved everything over except yourself.
Nothing new grows until you admit you've arrived.

items.sourceNote: 2026 陸劇市井群像與職人視角風潮，此則改寫為渡口艄公的世代對照獨白，台詞為原創撰寫，非劇中原句

zh-tw.content: 我在這渡口撐了三十年船，同一條河，來回不知幾千趟。頭十年我還記得每一張臉，後來記不住了，只記得人上船的樣子——往對岸去的，包袱捆得死緊，話也特別多；往這邊回的，多半空著手，一路不吭聲。前幾日有個後生上了船，包袱捆得比誰都緊，嘴也停不下來，我一眼就認出來：三十年前坐在同一個位子上的，是他爹。我沒說破，只把篙撐得慢了些，讓他多看兩眼這條河。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合寫離鄉、送孩子出遠門、父子兩代走同一條路的心情；配渡口、河面或老船夫的劇照都很搭。
variations: 這條河我撐了三十年，載走的一直是同一種年輕人。
我沒攔他，只是把船撐慢了一點。

en.content: I've poled this ferry for thirty years — same river, more crossings than I could count. The first ten years I remembered every face; after that I only remembered how people boarded. The ones heading across rope their bundles tight and talk the whole way; the ones coming back come empty-handed and say nothing. A few days ago a young man got on with his bundle roped tighter than anyone's and his mouth going nonstop, and I knew him instantly: thirty years back, his father sat in that exact spot. I didn't say so — I just poled a little slower so he'd get a longer look at the river.
en.editorNote: For posts about leaving home, sending a kid off, or a son walking the same road his father walked; works with river, ferry, and departure imagery.
variations: Thirty years on this river and it's always the same young man leaving.
I didn't stop him. I just slowed the boat down.

items.sourceNote: 2026 古裝權謀劇的密談與識人橋段母題，此則改寫為主家對來客的第二人稱指認，台詞為原創撰寫，非劇中原句

zh-tw.content: 你進門先往屏風後頭看了一眼，坐下之後茶碗在兩隻手裡換了三回，我提到南邊那樁事的時候，你點頭點得比誰都快。這些我都不介意。可你從頭到尾沒問過我要什麼——來談生意的人會先問，來收帳的人才不問。今日你要的東西我照給，下回請帶著問題再來。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合權謀劇解析、談判與識人主題；也可以寫給那種「表面客氣、其實已經來清算」的合作對象。
variations: 你哪裡都滴水不漏，就是忘了問我一句。
肯問我要什麼的人，才是真的來談的。

en.content: You glanced behind the screen before you sat down, you moved the teacup between your hands three times, and when I mentioned the business down south you nodded faster than anyone in the room. None of that bothers me. What bothers me is that you never once asked what I wanted — people who come to negotiate ask first; people who come to collect don't bother. You'll get what you came for today, but next time bring a question.
en.editorNote: For political-drama breakdowns, negotiation and reading-the-room posts, or that partner who's all courtesy and already settling accounts.
variations: You covered every angle except asking me one question.
The ones who ask what you want are the ones actually here to talk.

items.sourceNote: 2026 甜寵古裝劇「職人設定＋日常暗戀」風潮，此則改寫為傘鋪掌櫃視角的誤會翻轉，台詞為原創撰寫，非劇中原句

zh-tw.content: 這三年只要落雨，他就上我這間傘鋪買一把新的，前後十一把，最貴的那款硬是讓我補了兩回貨。街坊都笑他是全城最會弄丟傘的人，我也這麼想，還好心在傘骨上替他刻了記號，好讓撿到的人送得回來。前些日子替他家送貨，我在廊下看見那十一把傘整整齊齊靠著牆，記號一個沒少，油紙上連一道水痕都沒有。他不是老弄丟傘，是下雨天才有理由走這一趟，走到我這條街上來。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合暗戀、久候未說破的曖昧貼文；配雨天街景、油紙傘或古裝劇雨中相遇的劇照。
variations: 他家牆邊那排傘全是新的，被走舊的是我這條街。
十一把傘，十一次他得下定決心出門。

en.content: For three years, every time it rained, he came into my umbrella shop and bought a new one — eleven in all, and I had to restock the priciest model twice. The whole street called him the most careless man in town and I thought so too, so I even carved a mark into the ribs, in case someone found one and brought it back. Last week I delivered goods to his house and saw all eleven lined up against the wall under the eaves, every mark still there, not one water stain on the oiled paper. He wasn't losing umbrellas. Rain was just the only excuse he had to walk down my street.
en.editorNote: For quiet-crush posts, or the years-long almost that never got said out loud; pairs with rainy streets, paper umbrellas, and meet-in-the-rain stills.
variations: Eleven umbrellas, all brand new. The only thing worn out was the road to my shop.
Eleven umbrellas is eleven times he talked himself into walking over.

items.sourceNote: 參考 2026 古裝陸劇片單中以匠人／職人設定為賣點的討論，重寫為鍛刀師徒對白，台詞為原創撰寫，非劇中原句

zh-tw.content:
「師父，這把刀我燒了六回、捶了六回，怎麼一入水就裂？」
「因為你每回都趁它最紅的時候丟下去。」
「不趁熱要趁什麼時候？」
「等它自己肯降一點溫，你再問它要不要跟你走一輩子。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合寫耐心、感情不能催的貼文；配鐵匠鋪爐火、火星四濺或古裝劇師徒對戲的畫面。
variations: 刀最紅的那一刻最好看，也最容易碎。
肯等它降溫的人，才留得住這把刀。

en.content:
"Master, I heated this blade six times and hammered it six times, so why does it split the second it touches water?"
"Because you drop it in while it's still at its reddest."
"When am I supposed to do it, if not while it's hot?"
"Wait until it agrees to cool a little on its own, then ask it whether it wants to stay with you for life."
en.editorNote: Good for posts about patience and not rushing someone, and it pairs with forge sparks, glowing steel, or a master-and-apprentice scene.
variations: A blade at its brightest is also a blade at its most brittle.
Whoever is willing to wait out the heat is the one who gets to keep the blade.

items.sourceNote: 參考 2026 古裝陸劇清單中山林／獵戶題材的觀眾討論，重寫為獵戶回憶母親的三條規矩，台詞為原創撰寫，非劇中原句

zh-tw.content: 我頭一回進山那年十四歲，我娘在門口交代了三件事：小的不打、懷崽的不打、天黑以前一定折回頭。前兩件我守了二十年，山裡的活物遠遠看見我也不太跑。第三件我破過一回，那晚我背著獵物摸黑往下走，看見半山腰有一盞燈在原地晃。她從入夜舉到天亮，手臂僵得放不下來，見了我第一句卻是問我冷不冷。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合寫家人等門、母親牽掛的貼文；配山林夜色、提燈剪影或古裝劇獵戶題材劇照。
variations: 山裡的規矩我學得快，家裡那盞燈的規矩我學了很久。
她舉了一整夜的燈，開口問的卻是我冷不冷。

en.content: The first time I went up the mountain I was fourteen, and my mother stood at the door with exactly three rules: nothing small, nothing carrying young, and be back down before dark. I kept the first two for twenty years, and the animals up there stopped bolting when they saw me coming. I broke the third one once, hauling a kill down in the dark, when I spotted a lantern swaying in one fixed spot halfway up the slope. She had been holding it since sundown, her arm too stiff to lower, and the first thing she said was to ask if I was cold.
en.editorNote: Good for posts about a parent waiting up all night, and it pairs with dark forests, lantern light, and hunter scenes from period dramas.
variations: The mountain's rules I learned fast; the one waiting at home took me years.
She held that lantern all night and asked only whether I was cold.

items.sourceNote: 參考 2026 下半年待播古裝劇中商旅／邊塞題材的宣傳討論，重寫為駝隊押貨人的兩年對照，台詞為原創撰寫，非劇中原句

zh-tw.content: 去年今日，我在西邊第三個驛外的沙丘上數駝鈴，數到四十七串，缺的那一串落在隊伍後頭沒跟上。今年今日，駝鈴還是四十七串，走在最末那一頭我沒讓別人牽。去年你說這趟走完就折回來，我信了，替你留了半囊水。今年我照樣留，水袋掛在先前那個鉤子上，晃了一路沒開過。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合寫久候、遠行未歸的思念貼文；配沙漠商隊、駝鈴特寫或古裝劇邊塞送別畫面。
variations: 駝鈴一串沒少，少的是搶著陪我走最後一段的那個人。
那半囊水我留了兩年，晃了一路都沒開。

en.content: A year ago today I stood on the dune outside the third western station counting camel bells, forty-seven strings in all, and the missing one was yours, trailing somewhere behind the line. Today there are still forty-seven strings, and the beast at the very back I let nobody else lead. Last year you said you would turn back once this run was done, so I believed you and saved half a skin of water. I still save it, hanging from the same hook, swinging the whole way and never once opened.
en.editorNote: For posts about waiting on someone who went far and never came back, paired with desert caravans, camel bells, or frontier farewell stills.
variations: The bells still count out the same; what's missing is whoever used to fight me for the last stretch.
Two years I've carried that half skin of water, and it has never been opened.

items.sourceNote: 參考皮影戲劇團傳承與後台操偶的報導，重寫為老藝師對新徒弟的交代，台詞為原創撰寫，非報導原文

zh-tw.content: 把手伸進燈裡之前，先看清楚影子落在哪一格幕上。今晚你替誰出聲不打緊，要緊的是你指節一頓，台前那個人就跟著遲疑。等你能讓一張硬皮走出人的猶豫，再回頭問我什麼時候讓你上場。記住，觀眾一輩子看見的都是那道影，看不見的這雙手得撐到散場。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合寫幕後付出、默默撐場的職人貼文；配皮影燈影、後台操偶或古裝劇戲班場景。
variations: 台前那道影替你說完的話，都是你指節先想好的。
看得見的是影，撐到散場的是手。

en.content: Before you put a hand into the light, look at where the shadow is landing on the screen. Whose voice you borrow tonight matters less than this: the moment your knuckles catch, the figure out front hesitates with you. Once you can make a piece of stiff hide waver the way a person wavers, come back and ask me when you get to perform. Remember that the audience sees nothing but that shadow, and the hands they never see have to hold out until the lamps go dark.
en.editorNote: Good for posts about the unseen people holding everything together, and it pairs with shadow-puppet lamplight, backstage hands, or a period troupe scene.
variations: Whatever the shadow finishes saying, your knuckles thought of it first.
What people see is the shadow; what lasts until the end is the hand.

items.sourceNote: 參考 2026 陸劇片單中家族商戰題材（如《家業》）的常見走向，情節與台詞皆為原創撰寫，非劇中原文

zh-tw.content: 三個兒子在帳房外站了一早上，等我說這間米行往後交給誰。我報出的名字他們一個也沒想到：那年鬧饑荒，我當著全街的面把他趕出門，他轉身卻把兩袋糙米搬到鄰家灶前。糧行的帳我算了四十年，難的從來不在那幾個數。荒年裡還肯把米送出去的那雙手，才守得住一間店。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合寫「誰才配接手」或善意勝過精明的貼文；可配古裝商賈、米行糧倉、家族戲場景。
variations: 糧行的帳我算了四十年，難的從來不在那幾個數。
荒年裡還肯把米送出去的人，才守得住一間店。

en.content: My three sons stood outside the counting room all morning waiting to hear who gets the rice shop. The name I said was the one none of them saw coming: the year the harvest failed, I threw him out in front of the whole street, and he turned around and hauled two sacks of coarse rice to the neighbor's stove. Forty years of ledgers, and the numbers were never the hard part. A pair of hands still willing to give rice away in a lean year is what holds a shop up.
en.editorNote: Good for posts about who actually deserves to inherit something, or generosity outlasting cleverness; pairs with period merchant, granary, or family-business stills.
variations: Forty years of ledgers, and the numbers were never the hard part.
Whoever still gives rice away in a lean year can run the shop.

items.sourceNote: 參考 2026 古裝劇片單中茶樓、市井群像類作品的氛圍設定，人物與台詞為原創撰寫

zh-tw.content: 我在城西茶樓當小二，今年第七個年頭。有位姑娘每逢初三就來，永遠坐靠窗那桌，永遠點兩盞茶，一盞放到全涼，一盞連碰都不碰。今年開春她改成只點一盞，我還以為她終於死心了，結果她把空出來的位子讓給了樓下賣花的老婦人。從那天起我端茶多留了個心眼：走得出來的人，會把空著的位子讓給還冷著的人。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合寫默默走出一段感情的貼文，用旁人視角更有味道；可配茶樓、靠窗座位或古裝日常劇照。
variations: 她點了幾年的兩盞茶，第二盞從來沒動過。
肯把空位讓出去的人，才是真的走出來了。

en.content: Seven years now I've been pouring tea at the west-gate teahouse. There's a woman who comes on the third of every month, always the window table, always two cups, one she lets go stone cold and one she never touches. This spring she started ordering just one, and I figured she'd finally given up, until I watched her hand the empty seat to the old flower seller from downstairs. Since then I've read the room differently: the people who actually make it out are the ones who let somebody cold have the empty chair.
en.editorNote: For posts about quietly moving on, told from the outside; pairs with teahouse, window-seat, or period slice-of-life stills.
variations: She ordered two cups for years and never once touched the second.
Whoever gives up the empty seat is the one who made it out.

items.sourceNote: 參考古代驛站、長途行旅路線的資料，改寫為江湖趕路的處世語錄，內容為原創

zh-tw.content: 行走江湖最不老實的兩個字，是「順路」。真順路的人不會替你多繞三十里山道，也不會在你歇腳的客棧外多守一夜。他總是把馬牽到岔口才回頭說路本來就這麼走，接著掉頭往反方向去。一輩子能遇上兩三個肯為你把路走歪的人，這趟就算沒白走。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合寫「有人默默替你多走一段」的友情或江湖情義貼文；可配山道、夜路提燈或俠客送別畫面。
variations: 沒有人會為了「順路」多繞三十里山道。
他嘴上說路本來就這麼走，那條路是替你彎的。

en.content: The least honest thing a traveler ever says is that you happen to be on his way. Nobody genuinely on your way rides thirty extra miles of mountain road for you, or stands one more night outside the inn where you're sleeping. He walks the horse to the fork, looks back, says the road always ran this direction, then turns off the opposite way. Meet two or three people willing to bend the road for you and the whole trip was worth it.
en.editorNote: For posts about the friend who pretends the favor cost them nothing; pairs with mountain-road, lantern-at-night, or wuxia farewell stills.
variations: Nobody rides thirty extra miles because it happened to be on the way.
The road he swears always ran that way got bent for you.

items.sourceNote: 參考 2026 上半年古裝劇榜單中離鄉／歸家母題的常見處理，台詞為原創撰寫

zh-tw.content: 總會有那麼一個黃昏，你在千里之外聞到一鍋熟悉的湯，手停在半空。那天你身邊多半站著一個不認得我的人，你會忽然想跟他說這條巷子第三戶的門檻有多矮。你不會回頭，我也沒指望你回頭。門檻我請人又削低了一寸，你哪天真彎不下腰了，也還是進得來。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合寫遊子、離家與家裡永遠留一個位置的貼文；可配巷弄、門前燈籠或古裝送別場景。
variations: 門檻我又削低了一寸，你哪天彎不下腰也進得來。
你不會回頭，這扇門照樣替你留著。

en.content: There will be an evening, a thousand miles from here, when you catch the smell of a familiar broth and your hand stops in midair. Odds are you'll be standing beside someone who has never met me, and you'll suddenly want to tell them how low the doorsill is at the third house down this lane. You won't turn back, and I'm not counting on you to. I had the sill shaved down another inch, so on whatever day you can't bend that low anymore, you can still get in.
en.editorNote: For posts about a home that keeps a place for you however long you're gone; pairs with old-lane, doorway-lantern, or period farewell stills.
variations: I had the doorsill shaved another inch, just in case.
You won't turn back, and the door stays open anyway.

items.sourceNote: 宮廷劇規矩／體面 register 參考（台灣媒體 Bella 儂儂宮廷劇金句盤點），內容為原創改寫，場景移至現代職場

zh-tw.content: 古裝劇裡替人斟茶，鏡頭總要給到手腕那個角度，說是規矩，也是替對方留的體面。同樣一個動作搬到公司茶水間，就成了年資最淺的人負責按熱水鍵。我在這台飲水機前站了三年，替整層樓接過的杯子數不清，倒是沒人問過我要冰的還是熱的。前幾天新人搶著替我接，我的手縮了一下才伸回去——同樣的動作，換我被做的時候，居然還要練習。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合寫職場資淺者的日常、辦公室人情與看不見的勞動；可配古裝斟茶劇照對比現代茶水間、飲水機或馬克杯照片。
variations: 同一個斟茶的動作，換個地方就換了一種重量。
替全層樓接了三年熱水，被接的時候我居然不會反應。

en.content: In the drama, pouring someone tea gets its own close-up on the wrist — it's protocol, and it's a way of handing the other person some dignity. Move that same gesture into the office pantry and it becomes whoever has the least seniority pressing the hot-water button. I've stood at that dispenser for three years and filled more cups than I can count, and nobody has ever asked whether I take mine hot or cold. Last week the new hire reached for my cup first, and my hand pulled back before it went out again — same gesture, but being on the receiving end apparently takes practice.
en.editorNote: For posts about junior-employee invisible labor and office dynamics; pairs a period tea-pouring still with a modern water cooler or mug shot.
variations: Same pour, different room, completely different weight.
Three years of filling everyone's cup, and I froze when someone filled mine.

items.sourceNote: 武俠師徒／兵器保養 register 參考（關鍵評論網金庸語錄評析），內容為原創改寫，場景移至機車行

zh-tw.content:
○七時二十分：捲門拉開，第一位客人開口就問「這台還能撐多久」。
○八時五十分：換煞車皮。他說還能騎，我說能騎和敢騎是兩件事。
一○時十分：老車進廠，車主二十二歲，車齡二十四年，是他爸留下來的。
一二時整：便當放涼，手上的機油沒空洗。
一四時三十分：學徒把螺絲鎖過頭，我沒罵，只讓他自己拆回來一次。
一七時四十分：有人來牽車，付完錢問我這台還能陪他幾年，我說看你騎不騎得溫柔。
二一時整：捲門拉下，工具照舊擺回原位——刀要歸鞘，人才睡得著。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合寫職人的一天、師徒傳承、老車與父輩情感；可配鐵捲門、工具牆或沾了機油的手部照片。
variations: 能騎和敢騎，中間隔的是有人肯替你檢查一遍。
工具歸位那一刻，這一天才算收工。

en.content:
07:20 — Roll-up door opens. First customer asks how much longer this thing has left.
08:50 — New brake pads. He says it still rides fine; riding it and trusting it are two different things.
10:10 — Old bike comes in. Rider is twenty-two, the bike is twenty-four, it was his dad's.
12:00 — Lunch goes cold. No time to get the grease off my hands.
14:30 — Apprentice overtightens a bolt. I don't shout; I make him back it out himself.
17:40 — A guy collects his bike, pays, asks how many years it has left in it. Depends how gently you ride, I tell him.
21:00 — Door comes down, every tool back where it belongs. A blade goes into its sheath, or nobody sleeps.
en.editorNote: For posts about a tradesperson's day, master-and-apprentice patience, or a bike inherited from a parent; pairs with shutters, tool walls, or grease-stained hands.
variations: Riding it and trusting it sit a whole inspection apart.
The day isn't over until every tool is back in its place.

items.sourceNote: 古裝離別／路引文牒 register 參考（MyDramaList 英文站期間劇台詞專文），內容為原創改寫，場景移至客運轉運站

zh-tw.content:
姓名：無關緊要，站務員只看班次。
出發地：住了十一年，還是講不慣這裡的腔。
目的地：家。地址寫不出來，客運會停。
隨行行李：兩袋、一床棉被、一句沒說完的道別。
出關事由：想在別人替我下定論之前，自己先走一步。
保證人：三年前借我搬家錢的那個人，他到現在沒催過。
歸期：欄位太小，寫不下。
備註：若有人問起，就說我往南去了，別說我回頭看了幾次。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合寫離開一座城市、返鄉或告別一段生活；可配轉運站月台、夜班客運座位或行李照片。
variations: 歸期欄太小，我索性空著。
若有人問起，就說我往南去了。

en.content:
Name: doesn't matter; the counter only checks the departure time.
Origin: eleven years here, and I still can't get the accent right.
Destination: home. I can't write the address, but the coach stops there.
Luggage: two bags, one quilt, one goodbye I never finished.
Reason for leaving: to go first, before anyone else decides what happened to me.
Guarantor: the person who lent me moving money three years ago and has never once asked for it back.
Return date: the box is too small.
Notes: if anyone asks, say I went south. Don't say how many times I looked back.
en.editorNote: For posts about leaving a city, going home, or closing a chapter of life; pairs with bus terminals, night coaches, or luggage shots.
variations: The return-date box was too small, so I left it blank.
If anyone asks, just say I went south.

items.sourceNote: 宮廷劇處世／自保 register 參考（台灣 TVBS 女人我最大金句整理），內容為原創改寫，場景移至停車場繳費機

zh-tw.content: 我站在停車場的繳費機前面，把票卡插進去，螢幕跳出停了四小時三十七分、該付一百二十元。趁機器數硬幣的空檔，我把手機翻過來扣在掌心，螢幕朝下。古人出城要交買路錢，交完就得走，沒有人可以站在城門口重新想一遍要不要出去。零錢一顆一顆落下來，我伸手接住，順便把一句話按回喉嚨裡——這趟見面，我從進場那一刻就想走了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合寫勉強赴約、應酬後的疲憊、想走又走不掉的心情；可配地下停車場、繳費機或深夜出口照片。
variations: 繳完停車費才發現，最貴的是那四個半小時。
買路錢好付，難的是付完還得裝作願意來。

en.content: I'm at the parking-garage pay machine feeding in my ticket; the screen says four hours thirty-seven minutes, one hundred and twenty dollars. While it counts my coins I turn my phone face-down in my palm. In the old stories you paid your toll at the city gate and then you left — nobody got to stand under the arch and reconsider whether to go out at all. The change drops one coin at a time, I catch it, and I push a sentence back down my throat: I'd wanted to leave since the moment I drove in.
en.editorNote: For posts about obligatory get-togethers, post-socializing exhaustion, or wanting to leave and staying anyway; pairs with underground garages, pay stations, or late-night exit ramps.
variations: The parking fee was cheap; those four and a half hours weren't.
The toll is easy to pay. Pretending I wanted to come is the expensive part.

items.sourceNote: 臺北市立圖書館「閱讀存摺點數折抵逾期日數」規定與各館逾期違約金計算方式（每日一元）為明細欄位參考，古裝藏書閣還書 register 為原創改寫，場景設在圖書館還書口

zh-tw.content:
借閱人：卡片認得我，姓名欄空著也放行
逾期天數：十一天，其中八天我從門口走過
違約金：每冊一元，合計十一元
折抵方式：閱讀存摺點數扣光，帳面歸零
投還時間：閉館後投進還書口，算成明天才還
館員備註：書角壓了摺，不追究
讀者自填：館裡少的是一本書，我少的是說要讀完那一夜
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合寫買了書卻沒讀完、對自己食言、遲來的收尾；可配還書口、書車或蓋著到期章的借閱單照片。
variations: 違約金十一元，欠自己的那一夜沒有標價。
書還了，答應要讀完的那個晚上還沒還。

en.content:
Borrower: the card knows me, so the name field stays blank
Days overdue: eleven, and I walked past the door on eight of them
Fine: one dollar a volume, eleven in total
Credit applied: reading-log points, all of them, balance back to zero
Returned: after closing, into the drop slot, so it counts as tomorrow
Staff note: corner creased, no charge
Borrower's own line: the library is short one book, and I'm short the night I said I'd finish it
en.editorNote: For posts about books you never finished, promises broken to yourself, or overdue closure; pairs with return slots, book carts, or stamped due-date slips.
variations: Eleven dollars for the book. The night I owe myself has no listed price.
The book went back. The evening I promised it never did.

items.sourceNote: 古裝劇「人間清醒」金句 register 參考（ETtoday 星光雲 2026 熱播古裝劇金句整理），內容為原創改寫，場景移至中藥行抓藥櫃檯

zh-tw.content:
抓藥人：替全家跑腿的那位，通常最後才顧到自己
帖數：七帖，一天一帖，第四天保證想偷懶
藥引：睡滿六小時，這味最貴，也最常缺貨
禁忌：忌生冷，忌深夜翻舊訊息
煎法：文火慢熬，火急了會苦
合計：三百四，老闆抹掉零頭
櫃檯附註：藥治得了的都算小病，剩下那些慢慢養
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合寫照顧者的疲憊、身體發出的警訊、學著對自己好一點；可配中藥行藥櫃、藥包或熬藥的砂鍋照片。
variations: 藥引寫著睡滿六小時，這味我缺了三年。
藥治得了的都算小病，剩下那些得自己慢慢養。

en.content:
Picking up for: the one who runs errands for the whole family and gets to themselves last
Packets: seven, one a day, and day four is when you'll want to skip
Key ingredient: six hours of sleep — priciest item on the shelf, most often out of stock
Avoid: cold food, and rereading old messages after midnight
Method: low flame, slow simmer; rush it and it turns bitter
Total: three-forty, the owner waives the change
Counter note: whatever medicine can reach is the easy part, and the rest you tend to slowly
en.editorNote: For posts about caregiver burnout, a body sending warnings, or learning to look after yourself; pairs with herb-shop drawers, paper packets, or a simmering clay pot.
variations: Six hours of sleep is listed as an ingredient. I've been out of it for three years.
Whatever medicine can reach is the easy part. The rest you tend to slowly.

items.sourceNote: 古裝劇守候／等人歸來台詞 register 參考（udn 女子漾 2026 熱播古裝劇金句盤點），內容為原創改寫，場景移至五金行配鑰匙攤

zh-tw.content:
「這把牙口都磨平了，再配也咬不住鎖。」
「照原樣打一副就好，我用習慣了。」
「習慣是你的事，門有門的脾氣。」
「那你替我多打一副。」
「多的那副要給誰？」
「先收著，哪天有人半夜想回來，總得讓人進得了門。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合寫替某人留一條退路、久等未歸的家人、無聲的守候；可配鑰匙串、五金行工作檯或門鎖特寫。
variations: 多打的那副先收著，總有人會需要。
門有門的脾氣，我還是替你留了一把。

en.content:
"The teeth on this one are worn flat. A copy won't catch anymore."
"Just cut it the same. I'm used to it."
"You're used to it. The lock has opinions of its own."
"Then cut me a spare."
"Who's the spare for?"
"Nobody yet. Someone might want to come back late one night, and they should be able to get in."
en.editorNote: For posts about leaving someone a way back, waiting on family, or quiet devotion; pairs with keyrings, hardware-store workbenches, or close-ups of a lock.
variations: I'll hold on to the spare. Someone always ends up needing it.
The lock has opinions of its own. I cut you a key anyway.

items.sourceNote: 古裝劇命定／抉擇金句 register 參考（食尚玩家 2026 熱播古裝劇經典金句總整理），內容為原創改寫，敘事者改為廟裡供桌上的籤筒

zh-tw.content: 我在這張供桌上站了三十年，聽過的心願比香灰還多。搖我的人手都在抖，抖到最後掉出來的那一支，多半是他們早就想好的答案。上上籤下下籤，我從來沒偏心過，我只負責讓人把話說出口。有人求完轉身就走，也有人跪在原地把籤詩讀了三遍，那三遍其實是留給自己聽的。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合寫猶豫不決、其實心裡早有答案、去廟裡求個安心；可配籤筒、籤詩紙或香爐煙霧照片。
variations: 掉出來的那一支，多半是你早就想好的答案。
籤詩讀三遍，第三遍是讀給自己聽的。

en.content: I've stood on this altar table for thirty years and heard more wishes than there is ash in the burner. Every hand that shakes me is trembling, and the stick that finally drops out is usually the answer they'd already settled on. Lucky reading or unlucky, I've never played favorites; my whole job is getting people to say the thing out loud. Some turn and go the moment they're done, and some kneel there reading the verse three times, that third time meant for their own ears.
en.editorNote: For posts about indecision, already knowing your answer, or seeking reassurance at a temple; pairs with fortune-stick cylinders, paper verses, or incense smoke.
variations: The stick that drops out is usually the answer you'd already chosen.
Read the verse three times and the third one is for you alone.

items.sourceNote: 古裝劇「守候／等一個人」台詞 register 參考（ETtoday ET Fashion《朝雪錄》8金句整理），內容為原創改寫，場景移至舊公寓一樓的信箱前

zh-tw.content: 三樓那位，每日散值頭一件事便是開信箱，鑰匙轉得極輕，像怕驚動裡頭睡著的誰。信封多是帳單與廣告，他仍一封封翻到底，翻完才肯上樓。街坊說他等的那人早搬走了，連地址都換過兩回。我替他把信箱的小鐵門合上，指腹壓在那道剝落的舊漆上，這才想起——這棟樓的三樓，只住我一戶。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合寫還在等一個不會來的消息、對舊關係的執念、自己騙自己久了會成習慣；可配信箱鐵門、剝漆牆面或成疊廣告單照片。
variations: 他等的那人早搬走了。這棟樓的三樓，只住我一戶。
翻到最後一封才肯上樓，翻的哪裡是信，是那點還沒死心。

en.content: The one on the third floor opens the mailbox first thing after work, turning the key so lightly you'd think something in there were asleep. It's bills and flyers, mostly, and still he goes through every envelope before he'll head upstairs. The neighbors say whoever he's waiting on moved out years ago and has changed addresses twice since. I close the little iron door for him, thumb pressed to the peeling paint, and only then remember that the third floor of this building has exactly one tenant.
en.editorNote: For posts about waiting on news that isn't coming, holding on to something already over, or a habit you've mistaken for hope; pairs with mailbox doors, peeling paint, or a stack of junk mail.
variations: Whoever he's waiting on moved out years ago. The third floor has exactly one tenant.
He reads every envelope to the last one. What he's checking isn't the mail.

items.sourceNote: 古裝劇甜寵／送嫁台詞 register 參考（ETtoday ET Fashion《逐玉》10甜寵金句整理），內容為原創改寫，敘事者改為送嫁的手帕交，場景設在婚宴會場休息室

zh-tw.content: 休息室到主桌是十九公尺，我陪她走過三十七趟，趟趟都是綵排。今日這一趟只走一次，我卻先在門邊站了整整八分鐘，把她裙擺第四層紗理了兩遍。方才替她補妝，粉撲落了三次，第三次她伸手按住我，說妳別抖。門一開便是二百四十位賓客，只有我知道，這十九公尺我從十七歲那年就開始練了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合寫送閨蜜或姊妹出嫁、多年情誼走到交棒的一刻、婚禮當天說不出口的心情；可配休息室鏡台、捧花或裙擺特寫照片。
variations: 十九公尺我陪她練了三十七趟，真要走的只有一趟。
粉撲落了三次，第三次她伸手按住我，說妳別抖。

en.content: It is nineteen meters from the green room to the head table, and I have walked it with her thirty-seven times, every one of them a rehearsal. Today we walk it once, and I stood by the door a full eight minutes first, smoothing the fourth layer of her skirt twice over. When I touched up her powder it slipped from my fingers three times, and on the third she reached out, held my hand still, and told me to stop shaking. Two hundred and forty guests are waiting on the other side of that door, and only I know I have been practicing these nineteen meters since I was seventeen.
en.editorNote: For posts about walking a best friend or sister down the aisle, a long friendship reaching its handover, or feelings you can't say out loud on the day; pairs with green-room vanities, bouquets, or skirt-hem close-ups.
variations: Thirty-seven rehearsals for nineteen meters. Only one of them counted.
The powder slipped three times. On the third she held my hand still.

items.sourceNote: 古裝劇「人間清醒」處世金句 register 參考（ETtoday ET Fashion《大生意人》7金句整理），內容為原創改寫，場景移至髮廊剪髮椅前的鏡子

zh-tw.content: 鏡子裡短了一截的那個人，肩上輕得不像我自己的肩。半個時辰前我對設計師說「都剪掉」，語氣穩得連我都信了。再往前推兩個月，我每回洗頭都從排水口撈起一把長髮，數過，沖掉，當作沒發生過。最初那日他說妳留長髮好看，我便留了六年，那六年裡沒有一寸是為自己長的。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合寫分手後剪髮、把別人的偏好還回去、重新拿回身體的主權；可配剪髮椅、地上碎髮或鏡面反光照片。
variations: 留了六年，沒有一寸是為自己長的。
說「都剪掉」的時候，語氣穩得連我都信了。

en.content: The person in the mirror is a good deal shorter now, and my shoulders feel lighter than they have any right to. Half an hour ago I told the stylist to take it all off, in a voice so steady I believed it myself. Two months before that, I was pulling a handful of long hair out of the drain every wash, counting it, rinsing it away, pretending nothing was happening. And at the very beginning he said long hair suited me, so I grew it for six years, and in all six years not one inch of it grew for me.
en.editorNote: For posts about a post-breakup haircut, handing someone's preferences back, or reclaiming your own body; pairs with salon chairs, hair on the floor, or mirror reflections.
variations: Six years of growing it out, and not one inch of it grew for me.
I told the stylist to take it all off, in a voice so steady I believed it myself.

items.sourceNote: 古裝劇「若當初／假設語氣」台詞 register 參考（udn 女子漾《後宮甄嬛傳》21句經典台詞回顧），內容為原創改寫，場景移至夜裡無人的學校操場跑道

zh-tw.content: 若那年最後一圈我沒有慢下來，此刻站在跑道邊的，該是替我按錶的那個人，而輪不到我自己。若我肯把腳踝的傷說出口，教練大約會換一種罵法，我也不必花十年去反覆想那句沒出口的話。若那日雨小一些，紅土不那麼滑，我大概還會一路跑下去。可是今夜操場空著，我穿著皮鞋走完四百公尺，走得比當年任何一圈都慢，也比任何一圈都甘願。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合寫放棄過的夢想、與少年時的自己和解、開學前回母校散步；可配夜間操場燈、紅土跑道或空看台照片。
variations: 若那年最後一圈我沒慢下來，站在跑道邊的就不會是我。
今夜我穿皮鞋走完四百公尺，比當年任何一圈都甘願。

en.content: If I hadn't slowed on that last lap, the one standing at the edge of this track tonight would be whoever held the stopwatch for me, and it would never have been my turn. If I had said out loud that my ankle was gone, the coach would have found a different way to shout, and I wouldn't have spent ten years replaying a sentence I never got out. If the rain had been lighter that day, if the clay hadn't been so slick, I'd probably still be running. But the field is empty tonight, and I walked the four hundred meters in dress shoes, slower than any lap I ever ran and more willing than all of them put together.
en.editorNote: For posts about a dream you set down, making peace with your teenage self, or a walk around your old school before term starts; pairs with night-lit fields, clay lanes, or empty bleachers.
variations: If I hadn't slowed on that last lap, I wouldn't be the one standing here.
Four hundred meters in dress shoes, slower than any lap I ran and more willing than all of them.

items.sourceNote: 古裝劇「硬撐到極限才鬆口」台詞 register 參考（陸劇星球盤點10部一句台詞就想到的古裝劇），內容為原創改寫，場景移至現代學校保健室

zh-tw.content:
我替自己訂過一個數字：三十八度五。沒到那個數，頭再暈都算撐得住，午休趴著睡掉一節課就當沒事。今天量出來三十八度七，我才肯把課本收進書包，跟老師說一聲我去躺一下。
古裝劇裡的人也這樣，非得在雪地裡走到咳出血，才准自己講一句「我撐不住了」。我沒有忽然變誠實，只是那個數字終於替我開了口。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合寫硬撐到最後一刻、身體先替你開口的那種累；也適合轉給那位永遠只回「我還好」的朋友，可配保健室白布簾、體溫計或午後窗光的照片。
variations: 沒燒到三十八度五，頭再暈都算撐得住——這是我替自己訂的規矩。
我沒有忽然變誠實，只是那個數字終於替我開了口。

en.content: I set myself a number: 38.5. Anything under that and the dizziness doesn't count; I just sleep it off at my desk through lunch. Today the thermometer read 38.7, and only then did I put my books away and tell the teacher I was going to lie down in the nurse's room. Costume dramas run on the same rule — the hero has to cough blood into the snow before he's allowed to say he's tired. I didn't suddenly get honest. The number just spoke up on my behalf.
en.editorNote: For posts about pushing through until your body forces the issue, or for the friend who always answers 'I'm fine'; pairs with an infirmary curtain, a thermometer, or afternoon light through a school window.
variations: Under 38.5 the dizziness doesn't count — that's the rule I set for myself.
I didn't suddenly get honest. The number just spoke up on my behalf.

items.sourceNote: 古裝陸劇「誤會多年才被拆穿」情節 register 參考（Marie Claire 6部虐心古裝陸劇，含《步步驚心》四爺與若曦因誤會錯過），內容為原創改寫，場景移至街尾修鞋攤

zh-tw.content: 三年來我一直嫌街尾那位補鞋的老師傅手拙：同一雙鞋交過去七回，左邊的跟總比右邊高出那麼一線，我拎起來對著光看，心裡罵過他多少遍自己都記不得。今日他沒出攤，換他兒子接手，兩邊釘得平平整整，我穿上走了三步，膝蓋一歪，才想起我左腿那年從馬背上摔下來過。那高出來的一線，是他量過我走路的樣子才留的。我回頭去謝他，攤前只剩一張空著的矮凳——有些話，總要到人不在了才聽得懂。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合寫錯怪了默默替你設想的人、遲來的理解、向老手藝人致意；可配修鞋攤、舊皮鞋或工具箱的照片。
variations: 我嫌了三年的那一線，是他量過我走路的樣子才留的。
有些話，總要到人不在了才聽得懂。

en.content: For three years I thought the old man who mended shoes at the end of the street was sloppy: same pair, seven trips back, and the left heel always sat a hair higher than the right. I'd hold them up to the light and lose count of how many times I cursed him. Today his stall was his son's, both heels nailed perfectly level, and three steps in my knee buckled and I remembered the year I came off a horse and wrecked that leg. That extra hair of height was measured off the way I walk. I went back to thank him and found nothing but an empty stool at the stand — some things you only hear properly once the person is gone.
en.editorNote: For posts about misjudging someone who quietly looked out for you, gratitude that shows up late, or the craft of small repair stalls; pairs with a cobbler's bench, worn leather shoes, or a toolbox.
variations: The flaw I complained about for three years was measured off the way I walk.
Some things you only hear properly once the person is gone.

items.sourceNote: 古裝經商／守物思人題材 register 參考（Bella 儂儂 20部必看古裝劇推薦，含《灼灼韶華》《錦繡芳華》等經商線），內容為原創改寫，場景設在商行倉房盤點

zh-tw.content:
盤點到第三排我停了手，先問自己一句：這批絹放了六年，年年翻曬、年年入帳，究竟在給哪一位買主留著？自己答得也乾脆——沒有買主。那年她走之前把絹託給我，說回來要親手裁一件冬衣；我把它記成一筆貨，帳面才平得下去，心裡那一筆從來沒平過。
再問一句：那還要留幾年？倉裡沒人接話，窗縫漏進來的光落在絹面上，替我答了：留到我肯把它記成一件事，不再記成一批貨。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合寫捨不得丟的舊物、放不下的人、年終盤點時的自我對話；可配倉房木架、成疊布匹或塵光的照片。
variations: 這批絹放了六年，年年翻曬入帳，其實從頭到尾沒有買主。
留到我肯把它記成一件事，不再記成一批貨。

en.content: On the third row of the stocktake I stopped and asked myself: this bolt of silk has sat here six years, aired and logged every single one of them — which buyer exactly am I saving it for? I answered just as quickly: there is no buyer. She left it with me the year she went away, said she'd cut a winter coat from it with her own hands when she came back. I entered it in the ledger as goods, because that's the only way the books balance; the entry in my chest has never balanced once. So I asked again: how many more years? Nobody in the storehouse answered, and the light through the window seam fell across the silk and answered for me — until I can log it as a thing that happened, and stop logging it as stock.
en.editorNote: For posts about objects you can't part with, someone you haven't let go of, or the questions that surface during a year-end stocktake; pairs with warehouse racks, folded cloth, or dust in a shaft of light.
variations: Six years aired and logged, and there was never a buyer.
I'll keep it until I can log it as a thing that happened instead of stock.

items.sourceNote: 古裝陸劇「對已逝之人說話」的第二人稱 register 參考（PopDaily 歷年必追古裝陸劇推薦），內容為原創改寫，場景設在山路上的第二座涼亭

zh-tw.content: 你當年教我，這條山路不必逞強，走到第二座亭子就把擔子卸下來，坐足一盞茶再上路。如今我腳程比你那時候還快，卸不卸都無妨，卻還是每回都在這裡坐滿一盞茶。亭柱上你刻的那一橫還在，我用指甲比過，比小指還短——那天你說要把我的名字刻全，只刻了一筆，天就黑了。山風照舊從左邊來，茶照舊涼得快，我把話說給空著的那半邊石凳聽，說完再走，剩下的半座山就不覺得長。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合寫思念離世或遠行的長輩、獨自走完對方教過的那條路、返鄉或掃墓途中的心情；可配山徑涼亭、石凳或午後山嵐的照片。
variations: 你說要把我的名字刻全，只刻了一筆，天就黑了。
我把話說給空著的那半邊石凳聽，說完再走，剩下的半座山就不覺得長。

en.content: You taught me not to muscle through this mountain path — set the load down at the second pavilion, sit for one cup of tea, then climb on. I walk faster now than you ever did, so the rest hardly matters, and I still stop here for the full cup every time. The single stroke you cut into the post is still there; I've measured it against my fingernail, shorter than my little finger — that was the day you said you'd carve my whole name, got one stroke in, and the sky went dark. The wind still comes from the left, the tea still cools too fast, and I say what I came to say to the empty half of the stone bench. Then I walk on, and the rest of the mountain never feels long.
en.editorNote: For posts about missing someone who died or moved far away, walking a route they taught you, or the trip home to visit a grave; pairs with a trailside pavilion, a stone bench, or afternoon mist on a ridge.
variations: You said you'd carve my whole name, got one stroke in, and the sky went dark.
I say it to the empty half of the bench, then walk on, and the rest of the mountain never feels long.

items.sourceNote: BEAUTY美人圈「零負評古裝劇 TOP8」片單（含《暗河傳》等江湖題材）作為古裝劇口吻參考；內容為原創改寫，敘事框為旁人轉述，場景設在廟埕

zh-tw.content:
那個賣傘的講得比我清楚，可我偏要自己再講一遍。
去年廟埕搭戲棚，台上唱到刀光那一折，姓沈的姑娘就靠在柱子後頭，從頭到尾沒往前擠。
散戲以後她把整包碎銀塞給敲鑼的老頭，只留下一句話：替我謝謝台上那位，他年輕時候救過我爹。
老頭問她怎麼不自己去說，她說人家早忘了，何必讓一份恩情變成一筆債。
我後來想通了，這世上最重的謝，往往繞了一大圈，是從別人嘴裡替你補完的。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合寫「不想讓對方有壓力，所以默默道謝」的心情，或轉述別人替你做過的事；也可用在幫忙牽線、代人致意的貼文，配廟埕、戲棚或夜市燈火的照片。
variations: 她說人家早忘了，何必讓一份恩情變成一筆債。
這世上最重的謝，往往是從別人嘴裡替你補完的。

en.content:
The umbrella seller tells it better than I do, but let me tell it my way.
Last year they raised an opera stage in the temple square, and when the sword scene came, the Shen girl stayed behind a post and never once pushed forward.
After the last gong she pressed a whole pouch of silver into the old drummer's hand and left one line with him: thank the man on stage for me, he saved my father years ago.
The drummer asked why she wouldn't say it herself, and she said he's long forgotten, and there's no sense turning a kindness into a debt.
I've decided since that the heaviest thanks are the ones that travel the long way around and reach you through somebody else's mouth.
en.editorNote: For posts about thanking someone quietly so they don't feel indebted, or passing on what a person once did for you; works for introductions made on your behalf, paired with a night market, a stage, or lantern light.
variations: He's long forgotten. There's no sense turning a kindness into a debt.
The heaviest thanks reach you through somebody else's mouth.

items.sourceNote: BEAUTY美人圈「2026 下飯神劇 TOP10」古裝片單，作為古裝劇語感與題材參考；內容為原創改寫，敘事框為旁人轉述，場景設在廟埕

zh-tw.content:
我在廟埕掃了三十年的地，看人比看戲還準。
那位穿青衫的公子逢初一十五都來，卻從來不進殿裡拜，只在石獅旁邊站上一炷香的工夫。
有回下大雨他照樣站著，我拿破斗笠遞過去，他說裡頭那位神明他不敢求，怕求了往後就得還。
再後來聽說他把家業全散給了城南遭災的人家，自己走了，連名字都沒留。
我掃到那塊石板總是多掃兩下，那是他一個人站出來的一小片乾淨。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合寫默默付出卻不留名的人、感謝從不邀功的朋友或長輩；也可用在志工、捐助、匿名幫忙的貼文，配廟埕石板、石獅或雨後地面的照片。
variations: 他說裡頭那位神明他不敢求，怕求了往後就得還。
那是他一個人站出來的一小片乾淨。

en.content:
I've swept this temple square for thirty years, and I read people better than I read plays.
The young man in the blue robe came on the first and fifteenth of every month, never went in to pray, just stood by the stone lion for about the time an incense stick takes to burn.
One day it poured and he stood there anyway; I handed him my broken hat, and he said he didn't dare ask the god inside for anything, because asking means owing.
Later I heard he gave away everything his family owned to the flooded households south of the city, then left without leaving a name.
I always give that one flagstone two extra strokes of the broom, because that patch of clean ground is where he used to stand.
en.editorNote: For posts about people who give without taking credit, or thanking a friend or elder who never claims any; fits volunteering and anonymous help, paired with worn stone, a temple lion, or wet pavement.
variations: He didn't dare ask the god inside for anything, because asking means owing.
That patch of clean ground is where he used to stand.

items.sourceNote: TVBS 新聞網「陸劇推薦 2026」古裝現代排行榜（《逐玉》等），作為古裝權謀／將領題材參考；內容為原創改寫，敘事框為旁人轉述

zh-tw.content:
我不過是替驛站抄路引的小吏，這故事本輪不到我來說，可我一說就說了三年。
那位女將軍換馬那天，把披風解下來蓋在凍僵的馬伕身上，自己只穿一件單衣就上路了。
旁邊的人喊她這樣要病的，她笑著說北地的風她認得，馬伕不認得。
如今她的名字被人從石碑上刮掉了，刮不掉的是那年冬天，這座驛站裡多活下來的一個人。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合寫被抹去功勞卻仍被記得的人、感謝護著你的主管或前輩；也可用在悼念、致敬冷門英雄的貼文，配雪地、馬廄或舊石碑的照片。
variations: 她笑著說北地的風她認得，馬伕不認得。
刮不掉的是那年冬天，這座驛站裡多活下來的一個人。

en.content:
I'm only the clerk who copies travel passes at the post station, so this story was never mine to tell, and I've been telling it for three years.
The morning the lady general changed horses, she took off her cloak and laid it over a stablehand who'd gone stiff with cold, then rode out in nothing but a single layer.
Someone shouted that she'd fall ill, and she laughed and said she knew the northern wind, and the stablehand didn't.
Her name has since been scraped off the stone tablet, but what nobody can scrape off is that one man lived through that winter in this station.
en.editorNote: For posts about someone whose credit was erased but whose effect wasn't, or thanking a boss or mentor who shielded you; fits tributes and remembrances, paired with snow, a stable, or a weathered stone marker.
variations: She laughed and said she knew the northern wind, and the stablehand didn't.
What nobody can scrape off is that one man lived through that winter.

items.sourceNote: Bella 儂儂「20 部必看古裝劇推薦」（《灼灼韶華》《子夜歸》等），作為師門／武俠題材語感參考；內容為原創改寫，敘事框為旁人轉述

zh-tw.content:
茶樓那位說書的，講到這一段總要停下來喝口水，我索性替他把後半段補完。
姓崔的少年學劍學了八年，師門大比那天卻故意輸給了同門的師妹，只因為她家中還等著這口飯。
有人罵他丟盡師門的臉，他一句都沒辯，隔天照樣天沒亮就去挑水。
八年之後師妹接了掌門，做的頭一件事，是把他的名字補回門牆上，而且補在最上頭。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合寫默默讓賢、成全別人的選擇，或多年後終於被證明的委屈；也可用在感謝當年替你退一步的同事、隊友，配木牆、劍架或老茶館的照片。
variations: 他一句都沒辯，隔天照樣天沒亮就去挑水。
她做的頭一件事，是把他的名字補回門牆上，而且補在最上頭。

en.content:
The storyteller at the teahouse always stops for a drink of water right at this part, so I'll finish it for him.
The Cui boy trained with the sword for eight years, then threw the school's grand match to a younger sister-in-arms, because her family was living on what that title paid.
People called him a disgrace to the school; he never argued once, and was hauling water before dawn the next day like always.
Eight years on she took over as head of the school, and the first thing she did was put his name back on the hall wall, right at the top.
en.editorNote: For posts about stepping aside so someone else can win, or vindication that arrives years late; fits thanking a colleague or teammate who once gave up their turn, paired with a wooden hall, a sword rack, or an old teahouse.
variations: He never argued once, and was hauling water before dawn the next day like always.
The first thing she did was put his name back on the wall, right at the top.

items.sourceNote: 維基百科「擲筊」條目（聖筊／笑筊／陰筊的判讀，以及連三聖筊才算數的習慣），作為廟中問神細節的考據參考；內容為原創改寫，敘事框為器物自述

zh-tw.content:
廟祝把我從紅布裡取出來時天還沒亮，香灰的氣味比人先醒。
頭一位來擲筊的姑娘，把我攏在掌心搓了三回才鬆手，我落地翻了兩圈，一俯一仰。
她沒起身，撿回去再問一次，這回兩片都平面朝上，神明笑而不答。
她問到後來聲音已經很小，我只聽見半句，落地時她的手還停在半空。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合寫遲遲等不到答案的心情、反覆確認同一件事的猶豫；也可用在拜拜、祈願、求籤的貼文，配紅布、香爐或廟裡石板地的照片。
variations: 她沒起身，撿回去再問一次，這回兩片都平面朝上，神明笑而不答。
落地時她的手還停在半空。

en.content:
The temple keeper lifted me out of the red cloth before dawn, and the smell of incense ash woke before any person did.
The first girl who came to cast me rolled me between her palms three times before letting go; I turned twice on the floor and landed one face up, one face down.
She didn't stand, just picked me up and asked again, and this time both flat sides faced the ceiling, the god smiling without answering.
By the last round her voice had gone very small, so I caught only half of it, and when I landed her hand was still up in the air.
en.editorNote: For posts about waiting on an answer that never comes, or asking the same question over and over; fits temple visits, prayers, and fortune-seeking, paired with red cloth, an incense burner, or worn stone floor.
variations: She picked me up and asked again, and both flat sides faced the ceiling.
When I landed her hand was still up in the air.

items.sourceNote: ETtoday「擲筊怎麼擲才正確」報導（稟報姓名住址、問法要簡明扼要，以及丁蘭以兩塊木板問母的起源說），作為問神禮節參考；內容為原創改寫，敘事框為器物自述

zh-tw.content:
我這道門檻被踩了一百二十年，中間凹下去一寸，比殿裡的燭台還常挨手。
昨夜有個少年跨過我時絆了一下，手裡的筊杯滾出去老遠，滾進我看不見的暗處。
他跪著把兩片都摸回來，在袖子上擦了又擦，才敢重新擲一次。
今早廟祝掃地，掃出一枚壓在我底下的銅錢，說不清是誰哪一年掉的。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合寫小心翼翼把事情重來一次的謹慎，或無人知曉的舊心願；也可用在老廟、老屋、老物件的貼文，配門檻、木地板或銅錢的照片。
variations: 他跪著把兩片都摸回來，在袖子上擦了又擦，才敢重新擲一次。
掃出一枚壓在我底下的銅錢，說不清是誰哪一年掉的。

en.content:
I'm the threshold that's been stepped on for a hundred and twenty years, worn an inch deep in the middle, handled more often than the candlesticks in the hall.
Last night a boy tripped crossing me and the moon blocks flew out of his hands, rolling off into the dark where I can't see.
He knelt and felt around until he had both halves back, wiped them on his sleeve over and over, and only then dared to cast them again.
This morning the temple keeper swept up a coin that had been lodged under me, and nobody could say who dropped it or in what year.
en.editorNote: For posts about being careful enough to start over, or old wishes nobody remembers making; fits old temples, old houses, and old objects, paired with a worn threshold, floorboards, or an antique coin.
variations: He wiped them on his sleeve over and over, and only then dared to cast again.
Nobody could say who dropped that coin, or in what year.

items.sourceNote: Marie Claire 美麗佳人「2026 陸劇推薦」片單（《百花殺》《昭陽公主》《唐宮奇案之青霧鳳鳴》等宮廷題材），作為宮廷夜戲語感參考；內容為原創改寫，敘事框為器物自述

zh-tw.content:
掛在東角門上的第七年，我的紙面換過三次，骨架還是原來那副。
夜裡巡更的人只看我亮不亮，沒人抬頭看我被風吹偏了多少。
有位娘娘曾在我底下站到四更天，鞋尖沾了霜也沒往裡走一步。
後來換了一批人掌燈，我照樣被點著，照樣照見石階上那一小塊踩白了的地方。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合寫長年待在原位、被使用卻不被看見的處境，或有話說不出口的深夜；也可用在久任、默默守候的貼文，配燈籠、宮牆或夜色石階的照片。
variations: 夜裡巡更的人只看我亮不亮，沒人抬頭看我被風吹偏了多少。
鞋尖沾了霜也沒往裡走一步。

en.content:
This is my seventh year hanging over the east side gate; my paper has been replaced three times and the frame is still the original one.
The night watchmen only check whether I'm lit, and nobody ever looks up to see how far the wind has pushed me off center.
One of the consorts once stood under me until the fourth watch, frost on the toes of her shoes, and never took a step inside.
Later a new set of hands took over the lighting, and I'm lit the same way, still throwing light on that one pale worn patch of the stone step.
en.editorNote: For posts about staying in one place for years, being used without being seen, or a night with something left unsaid; fits long tenures and quiet waiting, paired with a lantern, palace walls, or stone steps at night.
variations: Nobody ever looks up to see how far the wind has pushed me off center.
Frost on the toes of her shoes, and she never took a step inside.

items.sourceNote: Bella 儂儂「2026 高評分陸劇推薦 Top8」（《逐玉》《玉茗茶骨》《月鱗綺紀》等），作為深宅閨閣題材語感參考；內容為原創改寫，敘事框為器物自述

zh-tw.content:
我被磨亮的那一面朝上，擱在梳妝檯左手邊，一擱四十年。
小姐十六歲那年天天照我，後來只在出門前掃一眼，再後來連掃也不掃。
她把我翻過去扣著的那幾日，屋裡的人走路都放輕了腳步。
今年春天有個小丫頭把我翻回來，拿袖子抹了兩下，我又照見同一張床、同一扇窗。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合寫時間在同一個空間裡走過的痕跡、一段不願被看見的日子；也可用在整理舊物、久違重逢的貼文，配銅鏡、梳妝檯或舊窗櫺的照片。
variations: 小姐十六歲那年天天照我，後來只在出門前掃一眼，再後來連掃也不掃。
我又照見同一張床、同一扇窗。

en.content:
The polished side of me faces up, propped on the left of the dressing table, and it's been forty years like this.
At sixteen the young lady looked into me every day; later it was one glance on her way out, and later still not even that.
During the days she turned me face down, everyone in the house walked more softly.
This spring a young maid turned me back over and rubbed me twice with her sleeve, and I'm looking at the same bed and the same window again.
en.editorNote: For posts about time passing in one unchanged room, or a stretch of days nobody wanted witnessed; fits sorting through old belongings and long-delayed reunions, paired with a bronze mirror, a dressing table, or an old window frame.
variations: Later it was one glance on her way out, and later still not even that.
I'm looking at the same bed and the same window again.

items.sourceNote: 維基百科「修正液」條目（一九五一年由貝蒂・尼斯米在自家調製、後以立可白之名註冊商標；塗上遮蓋錯字、乾後可重新書寫），作為文具細節考據；內容為原創改寫，敘事框為場面描述＋反問收尾

zh-tw.content:
抄劇裡那句「山高水長」的時候，我把長寫成了常，順手抓了立可白蓋過去。
白色那一塊乾了以後微微凸起，指腹壓下去還摸得出底下那個錯字。
那一頁後來被我翻到起毛邊，凸起的地方反而最先泛黃。
你翻回自己抄台詞的本子，上面還剩幾塊那樣的白？
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合寫錯過又硬要補救的痕跡、抄寫劇中台詞的追劇日常；也可用在文具、手寫筆記的貼文，配筆記本、鋼筆或桌面文具的照片。
variations: 短版：白色那一塊乾了以後微微凸起，指腹壓下去還摸得出底下那個錯字。
延伸版：那一頁被我翻到起毛邊，凸起的地方反而最先泛黃；你自己那本上面還剩幾塊那樣的白？

en.content:
Copying the line about high mountains and long rivers, I wrote the wrong character and reached straight for the correction fluid.
Once the white patch dried it sat slightly raised, and pressing a fingertip on it you could still feel the mistake underneath.
That page later frayed at the edge from being turned so often, and the raised spot was the first part to yellow.
Flip back through your own notebook of copied lines: how many of those white patches are left on it?
en.editorNote: For posts about covering up a small mistake and the mark it leaves, or the habit of copying favorite drama lines by hand; fits stationery and handwriting posts, paired with a notebook, a pen, or a desk shot.
variations: Short version: Once the white patch dried it sat slightly raised, and you could still feel the mistake underneath.
Long version: That page frayed from being turned so often and the raised spot yellowed first; how many of those white patches are left in your own notebook?

items.sourceNote: NOWnews 報導立可白瓶蓋上的小圓圈設計用途（廠商說明為止滑、方便旋開，沿用七十餘年），作為文具細節考據；內容為原創改寫，敘事框為場面描述＋反問收尾

zh-tw.content:
第十二集那個人下線的那天晚上，我把筆記本裡他的名字塗成一片白。
立可白刷一次蓋不住，來回三次，紙都皺得像被雨打過。
隔天上課低頭翻開，白色底下那三個字還是浮起一點淡淡的灰。
你當年是把名字塗掉，還是整頁撕下來丟了？
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合寫追劇追到角色下線的難受、想把某段記憶蓋掉卻蓋不乾淨；也可用在劇情雷、角色卡的貼文，配筆記本、劇照或深夜書桌的照片。
variations: 短版：立可白刷一次蓋不住，來回三次，紙都皺得像被雨打過。
延伸版：白色底下那三個字還是浮起一點淡淡的灰；你當年是塗掉，還是整頁撕下來丟了？

en.content:
The night that character was written out in episode twelve, I painted his name in my notebook over into a solid white.
One pass of correction fluid wouldn't cover it, so I went back three times until the paper crumpled like it had been rained on.
In class the next day I opened it and the three characters still surfaced under the white as a faint gray.
Back then, did you paint the name out, or tear the whole page off and throw it away?
en.editorNote: For posts about a favorite character being written out, or trying to cover a memory that keeps showing through; fits spoiler talk and character cards, paired with a notebook, a still from the show, or a late-night desk.
variations: Short version: One pass of correction fluid wouldn't cover it, so I went back three times until the paper crumpled.
Long version: The three characters still surfaced under the white as a faint gray; did you paint the name out, or tear the page off?

items.sourceNote: friDay 影音「10 部經典古裝陸劇推薦」片單（《琅琊榜》《步步驚心》等），作為宮廷／權謀語感參考；內容為原創改寫，敘事框為場面描述＋反問收尾

zh-tw.content:
戲裡那位娘娘被廢的那年，宮牆上她的封號是拿石灰蓋掉的。
石灰只薄薄一層，一到梅雨季就從裡頭透出兩筆墨色。
守門的老兵年年拿刷子補，補到後來連筆畫都描歪了。
你若真走過那面牆，還認得出底下原本刻的是哪三個字嗎？
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合寫被抹去卻抹不乾淨的過去、名字被人從紀錄裡拿掉的處境；也可用在宮廷劇、權謀劇的貼文，配宮牆、石灰白牆或雨後苔痕的照片。
variations: 短版：石灰只薄薄一層，一到梅雨季就從裡頭透出兩筆墨色。
延伸版：守門的老兵年年拿刷子補，補到連筆畫都描歪了；你還認得出底下刻的是哪三個字嗎？

en.content:
The year that consort was deposed in the show, her title on the palace wall was covered over with lime.
The lime went on thin, and every rainy season two strokes of ink would bleed back through it.
The old gate guard repainted it year after year, until even the strokes he traced had gone crooked.
If you really walked past that wall, could you still make out which three characters were carved underneath?
en.editorNote: For posts about a past that keeps showing through no matter how it's covered, or a name taken out of the record; fits palace and court-intrigue dramas, paired with palace walls, whitewash, or moss after rain.
variations: Short version: The lime went on thin, and every rainy season two strokes of ink would bleed back through.
Long version: The guard repainted it year after year until the strokes went crooked; could you still make out the three characters underneath?

items.sourceNote: 中嘉寬頻「2026 陸劇推薦排行榜」古裝／家族題材片單，作為宗族、家業敘事語感參考；內容為原創改寫，敘事框為場面描述＋反問收尾

zh-tw.content:
族譜攤平在八仙桌上，我三叔公那一格黑得發亮，墨蓋了不只一遍。
家裡誰都不提起他，逢年過節那一排的香也少插一炷。
今年清明重抄一本，工匠拿筆問我，那格要留白還是照舊。
你們家那本簿子翻到中間，被墨蓋掉的名字現在還剩幾個？
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合寫家族中被略過的那個人、被刻意留白的一段往事；也可用在清明、祭祖、整理老物件的貼文，配族譜、八仙桌或香爐的照片。
variations: 短版：家裡誰都不提起他，逢年過節那一排的香也少插一炷。
延伸版：工匠拿筆問我，那格要留白還是照舊；你們家那本簿子裡被蓋掉的名字還剩幾個？

en.content:
The clan register lay flat on the square table, and my great-uncle's cell was glossy black, gone over in ink more than once.
Nobody at home brings him up, and at the holidays that row gets one stick of incense fewer.
This spring a new copy was made, and the copyist looked up and asked whether that cell should be left blank or filled in as before.
Open your family's book to the middle: how many inked-over names are still in there?
en.editorNote: For posts about the relative nobody mentions, or a chapter deliberately left blank; fits tomb-sweeping season, ancestor rites, and sorting through old things, paired with a clan register, a square table, or an incense burner.
variations: Short version: Nobody at home brings him up, and at the holidays that row gets one stick of incense fewer.
Long version: The copyist asked whether that cell should be left blank or filled in as before; how many inked-over names are still in your family's book?

items.sourceNote: mybest 台灣站靜電除塵撢／拋棄式除塵紙選購與使用說明（靜電吸附毛髮灰塵、髒了直接換一張），作為清潔道具細節考據；內容為原創改寫，敘事框為物件當敘述者

zh-tw.content:
我被掛在道具間第二排，刃是軟的，握把纏的布已經鬆了半圈。
收工那晚有人拿除塵紙從我的鞘上抹過去，一張抹到發黑，換第二張才抹到底。
他們把我裝進木箱，箱蓋壓下來以前，我看見同一排還空著七個掛勾。
下一季開拍前那七個掛勾陸續有人補上，我還在木箱裡。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合寫戲殺青後被收起來的道具、也適合寫「熱鬧散場之後」的心情；可用在追劇心得、殺青照、劇組幕後花絮的貼文，配道具間、木箱或刀劍特寫。
variations: 短版：收工那晚有人拿除塵紙從我的鞘上抹過去，一張抹到發黑。
延伸版：箱蓋壓下來以前，同一排還空著七個掛勾；下一季開拍前它們陸續有人補上，我還在木箱裡。

en.content:
I hang on the second rack in the prop room; my blade is soft, and the cloth wound around my grip has come loose by half a turn.
The night we wrapped, someone ran a dusting sheet down my scabbard, and one sheet went black before a second could reach the tip.
They packed me into a wooden crate, and before the lid came down I saw seven hooks still empty on that same rack.
By the time the next season began filming, those seven hooks were filled in one after another, and I was still in the crate.
en.editorNote: For posts about props packed away once a shoot ends, or the mood after everyone leaves; fits rewatch notes, wrap-day photos, and behind-the-scenes content, paired with a prop room, a wooden crate, or a close-up of a blade.
variations: Short version: The night we wrapped, someone ran a dusting sheet down my scabbard and one sheet went black.
Long version: Before the lid came down, seven hooks were still empty on that rack; by the next season they were filled one after another, and I was still in the crate.

items.sourceNote: mybest 台灣站除塵撢推薦與注意事項（防靜電款適用書籍、擺飾、燈具等不宜碰水的物件，避免刮傷表面），作為戲服／頭面保養細節考據；內容為原創改寫，敘事框為物件當敘述者

zh-tw.content:
架上第三頂頭面就是我，珠子少了兩顆，補上的那兩顆顏色淺一階。
她們隔著除塵紙抹我的簷邊，力道輕到聽不見聲音，抹過的地方會亮出一小塊。
上一個戴我的人卸妝時哭了，眼淚落進我的絨布襯裡，乾掉以後留下一圈白。
今年換了人戴，那圈白還在襯裡上，她們說不礙事，鏡頭拍不進來。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合寫換角、接棒、或某段感情留下的痕跡；可用在古裝劇造型、頭面妝造、劇迷回顧的貼文，配鳳冠、髮飾或化妝間鏡台的照片。
variations: 短版：她們隔著除塵紙抹我的簷邊，力道輕到聽不見聲音。
延伸版：眼淚乾掉以後留下一圈白，今年換了人戴那圈白還在；她們說不礙事，鏡頭拍不進來。

en.content:
I'm the third headpiece on the shelf; two beads are gone, and the two put in their place are a shade paler.
They wipe my brim through a dusting sheet, so lightly it makes no sound, and wherever it passes a small patch comes up bright.
The last person who wore me cried while taking her makeup off, and the tears fell into my felt lining and dried into a white ring.
Someone else wears me this year and the white ring is still on the lining; they say it doesn't matter, the camera can't reach in there.
en.editorNote: For posts about a role passed on, a replacement, or a mark some love left behind; fits costume-drama styling, headdress and makeup content, and fan retrospectives, paired with a phoenix crown, hair ornaments, or a dressing-room mirror.
variations: Short version: They wipe my brim through a dusting sheet, so lightly it makes no sound.
Long version: The tears dried into a white ring and it's still on the lining this year; they say it doesn't matter, the camera can't reach in there.

items.sourceNote: 美麗佳人「2026 陸劇推薦｜60 部必追古裝、現代、懸疑片單」宮廷／權謀作品清單，作為深宮敘事語感參考；內容為原創改寫，敘事框為物件當敘述者

zh-tw.content:
銅面是我，磨過七遍才照得出人，她們把我擺在妝台的左手邊。
她每回坐下先把我偏半寸，說這樣光不會落在眼下那塊。
後宮換過三批人，擦我的絹布換得更勤，一年用掉四匹。
最末那年沒人再偏我，我照的一直是同一面帳子。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合寫被冷落之後的日常、也適合寫一個人習慣被記住又被忘記；可用在宮廷劇、深宮題材的貼文，配銅鏡、妝台或帳幔的照片。
variations: 短版：她每回坐下先把我偏半寸，說這樣光不會落在眼下那塊。
延伸版：後宮換過三批人，擦我的絹布一年用掉四匹；最末那年沒人再偏我，我照的一直是同一面帳子。

en.content:
The bronze face is me, ground down seven times before it would hold a person, and they set me at the left hand of her dressing table.
Every time she sat down she tilted me half an inch first, saying the light wouldn't fall on the skin under her eyes that way.
Three sets of women passed through the inner palace, and the silk used to polish me was changed more often, four bolts a year.
That final year no one tilted me anymore, and what I held was the same bed curtain the whole time.
en.editorNote: For posts about the quiet stretch after someone stops being favored, or about being remembered and then forgotten; fits palace dramas and inner-court stories, paired with a bronze mirror, a dressing table, or bed curtains.
variations: Short version: Every time she sat down she tilted me half an inch first, saying the light wouldn't fall under her eyes that way.
Long version: Three sets of women passed through and the silk for polishing me was changed four bolts a year; that final year no one tilted me, and I held the same bed curtain the whole time.

items.sourceNote: MyVideo 影音週報「2026 必看陸劇推薦」古裝、家族與經商題材整理，作為市井店家敘事語感參考；內容為原創改寫，敘事框為物件當敘述者

zh-tw.content:
木頭是我，掛在藥鋪門楣上二十九年，金漆掉到只認得出兩個字。
夏天蟲蛀了我左下角，老掌櫃搬凳子上來，順著木紋刷了一刻鐘。
他兒子接手那年把我拆下，量過長短，說新的要做成一樣寬。
新的掛上去以後我靠在後院牆邊，雨水從我背面走，走出三道白痕。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合寫老店交棒、被換掉的老東西、也適合寫默默撐了很久的人；可用在家業、經商、老屋整修題材的貼文，配木匾、藥鋪門面或斑駁金漆的照片。
variations: 短版：夏天蟲蛀了我左下角，老掌櫃搬凳子上來，順著木紋刷了一刻鐘。
延伸版：他兒子接手那年把我拆下，說新的要做成一樣寬；新的掛上去以後，雨水從我背面走出三道白痕。

en.content:
The wood is me, hung over the herb shop's door lintel for twenty-nine years, the gilding worn down until only two characters read.
In summer insects ate into my lower left corner, and the old shopkeeper carried a stool up and brushed along the grain for a quarter of an hour.
The year his son took over he lifted me down, measured my length, and said the new one had to be made exactly this wide.
After the new one went up I was leaned against the back courtyard wall, and rainwater ran down my back and wore three white streaks into it.
en.editorNote: For posts about an old shop changing hands, an old thing swapped out, or someone who held on quietly for years; fits family-business, merchant, and old-house renovation content, paired with a wooden shop sign, a herb shop front, or flaking gilt.
variations: Short version: In summer insects ate into my lower left corner, and the old shopkeeper brushed along the grain for a quarter of an hour.
Long version: The year his son took over he lifted me down and said the new one had to be exactly this wide; rainwater then wore three white streaks down my back.

items.sourceNote: 痞客邦「布手作工具介紹」中【縫線類】段落（手縫線／車縫線番數、粗細與用途差異），作為戲服縫補道具細節考據；內容為原創改寫，敘事框為條列清單體

zh-tw.content:
— 戲服間那排縫線軸按角色分，正紅那軸最粗，也用得最凶。
— 女主角的嫁衣補過四回，補到第三回師傅就不再問是哪一場。
— 反派的黑袍只補領口，他每一集都要被人揪著往牆上按。
— 灰袍的小太監幾乎不動針，破了就換一件，鏡頭只帶到腰。
— 男二那軸月白色從頭到尾沒開封，他的戲在殺青前一週被剪掉大半。
— 殺青那晚師傅把線軸推回架上，正紅那軸剩下一層紙。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合寫「戲份多寡看得見」的殘酷，也適合寫默默替別人收尾的人；可用在追劇心得、幕後花絮、古裝造型的貼文，配戲服架、針線籃或劇照特寫。
variations: 短版：女主角的嫁衣補過四回，補到第三回師傅就不再問是哪一場。
延伸版：男二那軸月白色從頭到尾沒開封；殺青那晚師傅把線軸推回架上，正紅那軸只剩一層紙。

en.content:
— The thread spools in the costume room are sorted by character; the crimson one is thickest and gets used hardest.
— The lead's wedding robe was mended four times, and by the third the tailor stopped asking which scene it was for.
— The villain's black robe only ever needs the collar redone, since every episode someone grabs it and shoves him at a wall.
— The young eunuch's gray robe barely sees a needle: tear it and they hand him another, the camera only reaches his waist.
— The second lead's pale blue spool was never opened, and most of his scenes were cut the week before they wrapped.
— On the last night of the shoot the tailor pushed the spools back onto the rack, and the crimson one was down to bare paper.
en.editorNote: For posts about how visibly screen time is rationed, or about the person who quietly cleans up after everyone; fits rewatch notes, behind-the-scenes content, and costume features, paired with a wardrobe rack, a sewing basket, or a still from the show.
variations: Short version: The lead's wedding robe was mended four times, and by the third the tailor stopped asking which scene it was for.
Long version: The second lead's pale blue spool was never opened; on the last night the tailor pushed the spools back onto the rack, and the crimson one was down to bare paper.

items.sourceNote: 國立傳統藝術中心「京劇服裝」介紹（蟒、帔、靠、褶與盔頭配件分類，及「寧穿破，不穿錯」的行規），作為宮廷戲服與針線房細節考據；內容為原創改寫，敘事框為條列清單體

zh-tw.content:
— 針線房的縫線軸擺滿三層架，最上頭那層留給喜事。
— 金線一年只准動兩回，動的時候得有人在旁邊看著。
— 素白的線誰都能取，宮裡一年用掉的比金線多上十倍。
— 娘娘的裙擺說收兩寸就收兩寸，改回去時線要拆得看不出痕。
— 拆線的活兒派給眼力最好的人，做久了眼睛先壞。
— 她們離宮那年，架上金線那軸還是滿的。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合寫喜事永遠留在最上層、日子卻是素色堆起來的處境；也適合寫把最好的自己耗在看不見的地方，可用在宮廷劇、繡品、老手藝題材的貼文。
variations: 短版：素白的線誰都能取，宮裡一年用掉的比金線多上十倍。
延伸版：拆線的活兒派給眼力最好的人，做久了眼睛先壞；她們離宮那年，架上金線那軸還是滿的。

en.content:
— The sewing hall keeps its thread spools on three tiers, and the top tier is saved for weddings.
— Gold thread may be taken down twice a year, and someone has to stand and watch while it is.
— Plain white thread anyone can take, and the palace goes through ten times more of it than gold.
— When a consort's hem is to come up two inches it comes up, and letting it back down must leave no trace of the stitches.
— Unpicking is given to whoever has the best eyes, and their eyes are the first thing to go.
— The year they left the palace, the spool of gold thread was still full.
en.editorNote: For posts about the good occasions kept on the top shelf while ordinary days pile up in plain white; also for spending your best years somewhere no one looks, and fits palace dramas, embroidery, and old-craft content.
variations: Short version: Plain white thread anyone can take, and the palace goes through ten times more of it than gold.
Long version: Unpicking is given to whoever has the best eyes, and their eyes are the first to go; the year they left, the spool of gold thread was still full.

items.sourceNote: 奇奇筆記「2026 最新陸劇收視率排行榜」古裝新劇整理（《尚公主》《夢花廷》等），作為武俠／師門敘事語感參考；內容為原創改寫，敘事框為條列清單體

zh-tw.content:
— 師父臨走那天交代四件事，沒一件跟武功有關。
— 米缸見底前三天就下山，別留到真的見底。
— 下雨不練刀，木鞘吃了水會從裡頭裂開。
— 有人問起我，就說我還在山上。
— 這把刀你先收著，用不順手也別急著換。
— 二十年過去，四件我做到三件，刀已經換過三把。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合寫長輩交代的話裡真正重要的往往最瑣碎，也適合寫沒能守住的那一件；可用在武俠劇、師徒情、離家與返鄉題材的貼文。
variations: 短版：師父臨走那天交代四件事，沒一件跟武功有關。
延伸版：下雨不練刀，木鞘吃了水會從裡頭裂開；二十年過去，四件我做到三件，刀已經換過三把。

en.content:
— The day my teacher left he named four things, and not one of them had to do with swordplay.
— Come down the mountain three days before the rice jar empties, not after.
— Don't train in the rain; a wooden scabbard that drinks water splits from the inside.
— If anyone asks after me, say I'm still up here.
— Hold on to this blade, and don't rush to trade it just because it sits wrong in your hand.
— Twenty years on, I've managed three of the four, and the blade has been traded three times.
en.editorNote: For posts about how the important instructions from an elder are always the small practical ones, and about the one you couldn't keep; fits wuxia dramas, master-and-student stories, and leaving or coming home.
variations: Short version: The day my teacher left he named four things, and not one of them had to do with swordplay.
Long version: Don't train in the rain, a wet scabbard splits from the inside; twenty years on I've managed three of the four, and the blade has been traded three times.

items.sourceNote: 吳軒手工皮包「如何挑選縫線」教學（材質、粗細番數與配色策略），作為針線與線軸細節考據；內容為原創改寫，敘事框為條列清單體

zh-tw.content:
— 她走那天在桌上留了一張紙，寫的全是我做不好的事。
— 熬藥的火要小，你每回都開得太旺。
— 米洗三遍才算，你洗兩遍就當數。
— 針收進竹籃，縫線軸靠著籃邊，別讓它滾到地磚上。
— 我照著做了兩年，紙的邊角磨破，線軸還靠在原來那處。
— 整張紙翻來覆去，沒有一句寫到她自己。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合寫愛是留下一整套怎麼過日子的細節，卻沒替自己留半句；可用在古裝甜寵、離別、思念題材的貼文，配針線籃、藥爐或舊紙條的照片。
variations: 短版：她走那天在桌上留了一張紙，寫的全是我做不好的事。
延伸版：我照著做了兩年，紙的邊角磨破，線軸還靠在原來那處；整張紙翻來覆去，沒有一句寫到她自己。

en.content:
— The day she left she put a sheet of paper on the table, all of it things I don't do well.
— Keep the fire low under the medicine; you always let it run too hot.
— Rice counts at three rinses, and you stop at two.
— Needles go back in the basket, the thread spool rests against its rim, don't let it roll onto the tiles.
— I followed it for two years, the corners of the paper wore through, and the spool still rests where it did.
— Turn the whole sheet over and back: not one line on it is about her.
en.editorNote: For posts about love that leaves behind a whole manual for living and not one line about itself; fits sweet period romance, partings, and missing someone, paired with a sewing basket, a medicine pot, or an old slip of paper.
variations: Short version: The day she left she put a sheet of paper on the table, all of it things I don't do well.
Long version: I followed it for two years and the corners wore through, and the spool still rests where it did; turn the whole sheet over and back, not one line on it is about her.

items.sourceNote: 中嘉寬頻「2026 陸劇推薦：5 月陸劇排行榜」古裝劇單整理（《唐宮奇案之青霧風鳴》《白日提燈》等），作為古裝劇迷追劇語感參考；內容為原創改寫，敘事框為自嘲式承認

zh-tw.content:
我去泳池會多帶一副蛙鏡，一副游泳用，一副拿來練沉在水底睜眼不眨。
那部戲裡的女主角落水三秒就把繩結解開，我在水下解自己的髮圈解了十一秒。
救生員問我還好嗎，我說我在練換氣。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合寫入戲太深、把劇裡的橋段搬進生活裡照著練的可愛執念；可用在古裝武俠、追劇日常題材的貼文，配泳池、蛙鏡或劇照的照片。
variations: 短版：一副蛙鏡游泳用，一副拿來練沉在水底睜眼不眨。
延伸版：戲裡三秒解開的繩結，我在水下解自己的髮圈解了十一秒；救生員問我還好嗎，我說我在練換氣。

en.content:
I take a spare pair of goggles to the pool, one for swimming and one for practicing how to sit on the bottom with my eyes open.
In the drama the heroine goes under and has the knot undone in three seconds; it took me eleven to get my own hair tie off.
The lifeguard asked whether I was okay, and I told him I was working on my breathing.
en.editorNote: For posts about getting so deep into a show that you start rehearsing its scenes in real life; fits wuxia costume dramas and everyday binge-watching, paired with a pool, a pair of goggles, or a still from the show.
variations: Short version: One pair of goggles for swimming, one for practicing how to sit on the bottom with my eyes open.
Long version: The knot takes three seconds on screen; it took me eleven to get my own hair tie off, and when the lifeguard asked, I said I was working on my breathing.

items.sourceNote: 中嘉寬頻「2026 陸劇推薦：5 月陸劇排行榜」宮廷權謀劇單整理（《藏海傳》《玉茗茶骨》等），作為宮鬥劇道具與語感參考；內容為原創改寫，敘事框為自嘲式承認

zh-tw.content:
包裡長期放著一把折扇和一副蛙鏡，扇子是看完宮鬥劇那週買的，蛙鏡是隔週買的。
折扇在池邊掉進水裡兩次，扇面的字糊掉一個角。
現在扇子只在冷氣壞掉時拿出來，蛙鏡照常每週用。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合寫一時衝動買下的追劇周邊，最後真正留在生活裡的往往是另一樣；可用在宮廷權謀劇、追劇消費題材的貼文，配折扇或包包內容物的照片。
variations: 短版：扇子是看完宮鬥劇那週買的，蛙鏡是隔週買的。
延伸版：折扇在池邊掉進水裡兩次，扇面的字糊掉一個角；現在它只在冷氣壞掉時拿出來。

en.content:
A folding fan and a pair of swim goggles live in my bag: the fan was bought the week I finished a palace-intrigue drama, the goggles the week after.
The fan has fallen into the water twice at the poolside, and one corner of the writing on it has blurred.
These days the fan only comes out when the air conditioning breaks, while the goggles get used every week.
en.editorNote: For posts about impulse merch bought in the glow of a series, and how the thing that actually stays in your life turns out to be the other one; fits palace-intrigue dramas and fandom spending, paired with a folding fan or the contents of a bag.
variations: Short version: The fan was bought the week I finished a palace-intrigue drama, the goggles the week after.
Long version: The fan has fallen into the water twice at the poolside and one corner of the writing has blurred; now it only comes out when the air conditioning breaks.

items.sourceNote: udn 售票網「2026 過年追劇推薦」片單整理（《國色芳華》《大生意人》等古裝商戰劇），作為古裝劇腔調與稱謂用語參考；內容為原創改寫，敘事框為自嘲式承認

zh-tw.content:
追完那部權謀劇的那個月，我傳訊息給同事全用「勞煩」開頭，連請假都寫得像在上奏。
同事回我一個貼圖，是一隻狗在敬禮。
我把那句改回「不好意思」，改完又把「勞煩」存進常用短語。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合寫追劇後語氣被整個換掉的那段時期，明明被笑了還捨不得刪；可用在古裝權謀劇、追劇日常與辦公室趣事題材的貼文。
variations: 短版：追完權謀劇那個月，我連請假都寫得像在上奏。
延伸版：同事回我一個貼圖，是一隻狗在敬禮；我把那句改回「不好意思」，然後把「勞煩」存進常用短語。

en.content:
For a month after that court-intrigue drama ended, every message I sent a colleague opened with "I humbly trouble you," and even my leave request read like a memorial to the throne.
A colleague sent back a sticker of a dog saluting.
I changed the line to "sorry to bother you," and then saved the old one into my quick phrases.
en.editorNote: For posts about the stretch after a series ends when its register takes over how you talk, and you keep the phrase even after being teased for it; fits court-intrigue dramas, binge-watching life, and office humor.
variations: Short version: For a month after that court-intrigue drama, even my leave request read like a memorial to the throne.
Long version: A colleague sent back a sticker of a dog saluting; I changed the line to "sorry to bother you," then saved the old one into my quick phrases.

items.sourceNote: udn 售票網「2026 過年追劇推薦」片單整理（台劇、陸劇與古裝劇十部清單），作為古裝造型與披風畫面的觀劇印象參考；內容為原創改寫，敘事框為自嘲式承認

zh-tw.content: 為了拍出戲裡披風揚起來的那種畫面，我把浴巾綁在肩上，對著電扇錄了二十三次。前面幾次布全往臉上蓋。最後一次風向終於對了，手機卻沒按到錄影。那條浴巾還掛在門後，一直沒收。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合寫為了一個畫面反覆折騰、最後還把道具留在原處的那種傻氣；可用在古裝造型、追劇模仿與生活趣事題材的貼文。
variations: 短版：我把浴巾綁在肩上，對著電扇錄了二十三次。
延伸版：最後一次風向終於對了，手機卻沒按到錄影；那條浴巾還掛在門後，一直沒收。

en.content: To get the shot where the cloak lifts in the wind the way it does on screen, I tied a bath towel around my shoulders and filmed twenty-three takes in front of an electric fan. In the early takes the cloth just landed on my face. On the very last one the wind finally came from the right side, but I had never actually hit record. The towel is still hanging on the back of the door, and I have not put it away.
